message: The binding of the field 'position' of entity 'Cube' must be pure, but it calls the CPU intrinsic `random`.
notes: a binding is re-evaluated every frame; it may read state, entity fields and `frame`, and call pure functions

a CPU intrinsic (`random`, `print`, `spawn`, `destroy`, a body command) may only be called from `update`, `fixed_update` and `on` handlers; a binding may call only `fn` functions and pure built-ins (math, vector, quaternion and colour functions)
help: call it in `update`, assign the result to a `state` and write `bind(that_state)`; the binding then follows the state every frame
